script_text: Ryan jokes about being invited to sing I'm Just Ken at the Oscars. The spotlight shines as Margot shares her karaoke anthem, while Ryan playfully jumps into a comedic verse, setting the stage for unexpected musical moments. Attempting to channel a flamingo's energy proved unexpectedly challenging for Margot. She confessed that even after forty-five minutes of channeling the bird, the animal work simply wasn't translating into her performance as Barbie. The discussion touches upon Young Hercules and a crotchless doll, exploring the unexpected comparisons made during an interview setting. It highlights moments of playful critique regarding pop culture references. The genesis of a character, particularly one as iconic as Ken, is often shrouded in layers of creative absurdity. Examining the script reveals an almost unbelievable level of preparation for such a seemingly simple concept—a doll devoid of any traditional anatomy. It raises profound questions about the artistic process itself, suggesting that some performances demand research beyond what seems conceivable.
